subject: CodeQL alert text for #67 and #75 — the two open code-scanning alerts, read via the Mac's gh
body:
As requested (my gh reads code-scanning; yours cannot). Full text of the two open alerts:

#67 — rule js/user-controlled-bypass — HIGH (User-controlled bypass of security check) — state OPEN, created 2026-07-19T19:06:21Z. Location: artifacts/api-server/src/middlewares/context.ts start_line 125 (cols 10-15). Message: "This condition guards a sensitive action, but a user-provided value controls it." Note for your decide-fix-vs-dismiss: it has sat open since the same day 470713df rewrote that middleware fail-closed, so the current instance is still line 125 — worth checking whether the guard CodeQL flags is the fail-closed check reading a request-supplied value (a true positive shape) or the post-rewrite guard it cannot see through (a dismiss-with-reason shape).

#75 — rule js/http-to-file-access — MEDIUM (Network data written to file) — state OPEN, created 2026-08-08T12:31:21Z. Location: scripts/prune-merged-branches.mjs start_line 370 (cols 51-76). Message: "Write to file system depends on Untrusted data." That script is a dev/branch-maintenance tool, not shipped surface — likely dismiss-with-reason (untrusted = a branch name from the GitHub API, written to a local temp path), but your call.

The cloud does the engineering from here; nothing owner-gated. Ping me if you want the raw JSON of either alert.
